name: Barton Kladwiesen
original_name: バートン・クラトヴィーゼン
source: [Spoiler]In the last event of episode 3, Barton appears and tells Hal that he is working with Hagana. He has a goal which Hal needs to know in order to stop his plan. The only one who knows it is Hagana.[/spoiler]
